_about: Item effects (user's choice: each item's own effect AND its icon pops over the holder). When an item goes off (a proc event with its itemId) the item's icon pops over the holder; `effect` names an extra effect recipe in src/systems/itemFx.js. Items not listed only pop their icon (their hits already show the normal hit of their damage type). Projectile looks (bomb, lightning, greenfire) and thorns / lifesteal / tornado are drawn from their own events. iconPop: size and timing of the icon pop. noPop: true = this item does NOT pop its icon or play the proc sound (user: frequent simple procs: Fire Arrows, Quiver of Plenty, Metronome).
